Description: Gold reverts toward the incentive price, the Marmato ramp slips a year and its post-expansion cost improvement only partly materialises, costs inflate faster than the deck, capital overruns and the tax rate is higher.
Guidance-consistent delivery with a fading gold price.
Gold stays structurally elevated, both expansions deliver on schedule, Marmato's bulk mining cost target is met or beaten and capital comes in on budget.
